items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: But Jimmie Lunceford and Duke Ellington, the whole time I was at home and could go and hear bands, they never played for the Black dances.

ctx.x: The only thing I ever heard of him was down through Louisiana, Mississippi, down through Arkansas -- down through that way, you know. But they really had some band. Yeah. And I heard, oh, so many bands that came through.

Now, Jimmie Lunceford I wanted to hear. But Jimmie Lunceford and Duke Ellington, the whole time I was at home and could go and hear bands, they never played for the Black dances. Maybe they couldn't afford them or something...
